test_title: PYST 36 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement:

No chair is a stool.

All stools are wooden.

Conclusions:

I. No chair is wooden.

II. Some wooden are not chairs.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
**Statement:**

No chair is a stool.

All stools are wooden.

Least possible Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/551bdf65cdf0953aea1c28400ba00f5578f2dcef47c415ebf02679ba8e990422.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. No chair is wooden→ Does not follow (There is no direct relation given between wooden and chair. so, it is possible not definite).

II. Some wooden are not chairs → Follow (All stools are wooden and no chair is stool. so, some wooden which are stool are not chairs).

Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 2”.
